name: Machimura Reona
source:
A cool but a bit of downer-type of person whose expressions have no ups and downs. She likes to talk and to make fun of Hilda. 

Leona was originally an honor student, but people's impression of her changed due to a certain event.

She went to the same elementary school as Tyler and Hilda.

Favorites: Chatting with Hilda, new sweets from convenience stores.
